newsitem.title: USA: Summit CEO David Muller fired - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Summit CEO David Muller fired - WSJ.

text.p: The board of Summit Technology Inc has dismissed founder and chief executive David Muller, The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
Muller, 47, will be replaced as chief executive by D. Verne Sharma, who was named president in April. Sharma will head an executive panel to devise a plan to increase profitability.
Muller's departure comes amid huge financial losses, a sharp stock decline and a dispute with rival VISX Inc.
The company's stock, which traded at $34 at the start of the year, closed on Thursday at $5.81 a share in Nasdaq trading.
